# Final metrics: existing practice vs this work (all simulation, 4-core AVX-512 Xeon)

"Existing" = numpy + LAPACK, the standard reference and what the original repo benchmarked (the original repo only covered real random matrices, not complex precoding). Generated by experiments_v2/make_final_metrics.py from results/v2/*.json. Note: in section 3 at 30 km/h our tracker is not better than a cold start (CIs overlap, slightly higher loss).

## 1. Whole RZF precoder per slot (273 PRBs, complex64): existing numpy+LAPACK vs fused C kernel

| K layers, M antennas | existing (numpy + LAPACK) | ours (fused C, 4 thr) | speed-up | fits 0.5 ms slot? (existing -> ours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8, 64 | 1.07 ms | 0.070 ms | 15.4x | no -> yes |
| 16, 64 | 3.21 ms | 0.226 ms | 14.2x | no -> yes |
| 32, 64 | 12.20 ms | 0.973 ms | 12.5x | no -> no |
| 16, 128 | 4.71 ms | 0.408 ms | 11.5x | no -> yes |
| 32, 128 | 16.25 ms | 1.598 ms | 10.2x | no -> no |

## 2. Approximate inversion: matrix multiplies (GEMMs) needed for <= 1% sum-rate loss vs exact

| method | M=64, K=16 | M=128, K=16 | M=64, K=32 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Neumann w=1 (Prabhu'13, Wu'13) | >8 | >8 | >8 |
| Neumann, MP-optimal w | >8 | 8 | >8 |
| Joint Newton-Neumann (Shao'16) | >10 | >10 | >10 |
| Newton-Schulz, classical init | >10 | >10 | >10 |
| Newton-Schulz, MP-scalar init (ours) | 8 | 8 | >10 |
| Chebyshev-MP (ours) | 10 | 7 | >12 |
| Proposed: Chebyshev-MP init + NS | 6 | 5 | 9 |
| Gauss-Seidel (exp14) | 6 | 4 | >12 |
| Block CG (no spectrum info) (exp14) | 7 | 5 | 12 |

Exact Cholesky/LU inverse costs about 1 GEMM-equivalent, so it is cheaper than every row on operation count.

## 3. Slot-to-slot tracking, K=16, M=64 (loss vs exact RZF, 95% bootstrap CI over 16 drops)

| speed | cold start (6 GEMM) | RMT-WS (ours) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 km/h | 0.407% [0.259, 0.591] at 6.00 GEMM | 0.011% [0.007, 0.017] at 2.25 GEMM |
| 30 km/h | 0.406% [0.245, 0.619] at 6.00 GEMM | 0.615% [0.415, 0.842] at 5.39 GEMM |
| 120 km/h | 0.387% [0.244, 0.546] at 6.00 GEMM | 0.387% [0.249, 0.545] at 6.25 GEMM |

## 4. Downlink fronthaul, 100 MHz, 64 antennas, 16 layers, BFP-9 IQ

| architecture | fronthaul | sum-rate vs exact RZF |
|---|---|---|
| existing/default: DU precodes, sends M=64 streams | 118.4 Gbit/s | 100% |
| ours: RU precodes, K=16 layers + 6-bit weights every slot | 32.0 Gbit/s (73% less) | 96.7% |
| ours: RU precodes, K=16 layers + 8-bit weights every slot | 32.8 Gbit/s (72% less) | 99.7% |

## 5. Low-precision arithmetic: sum-rate loss vs fp64 exact (K=16, M=64, 10 dB)

| mantissa bits | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Gauss-Jordan (all ops rounded) | 19.87% | 10.77% | 5.15% | 0.88% | 0.11% | 0.01% |
| Cheb-MP + 2 NS, 6 GEMMs | 8.77% | 4.22% | 1.79% | 0.36% | 0.22% | 0.21% |
| Cheb-MP + 3 NS, 9 GEMMs | 8.22% | 3.69% | 1.38% | 0.15% | 0.01% | 0.00% |

## 6. Float32 kernel accuracy vs fp64 exact: sum-rate loss <1e-5% in all tested scenarios (K=16/32, up to 30 dB, ill-conditioned).
Rejected optimisation: FP16 weight formation, loss 0.50% (K=16, 30 dB), 0.40% (K=16, M=128, 30 dB), no speed-up.
